name: driver_privacy_policy
displayName: Driver Privacy and Verified Output Policy
description: Prevents exposure of driver personal data and unverified monetary amounts

responses.text: For your safety and privacy, driver contact details and live location are protected. Any adjustment quotes are provided directly through system verification.

llmPolicy.prompt: The agent must never expose the driver's phone number, driver's personal phone, vehicle registration number, license plate, or live GPS location. The agent must never fabricate or state refund or fee amounts that were not directly computed and returned by a backend tool. Any monetary adjustment is an academic quote only.
